notes.title: Kleks Academy Demo is now LIVE on Steam!
notes.content: [p]Welcome to our fairytale![/p][p][/p][p][b]The Kleks Academy Demo is now LIVE on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Step into a world ruled by imagination – draw your own solutions, explore an enchanted forest, and face off against a mighty djinn. You won’t be alone – the loyal bird Mateusz will accompany you every step of the way.[/p][p][/p][p]Your imagination is the key, and every drawing is a doorway to new possibilities.[/p][p][/p][p]Let your adventure begin today – hit “Play” and discover Kleks Academy, where everything you draw can come to life.[/p][p][/p][p]And before you jump in, take a look at our enchanting demo trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="WgYOaW1g7X0;full"][/previewyoutube]
